0022600118.text: The Sacramento Kings, 0-2 and 14th in the West, host the 2-0 Memphis Grizzlies, who sit 5th in the West, in the Kings' third game of the season. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee, who averaged 12.5 points in 26.5 minutes last season), while Memphis is missing Cedric Coward (wrist sprain). The two teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Kings lost the season series 1-3, though they won the most recent meeting 123-114 in Memphis on February 23, 2026.
